headline: Aolani announces plans for 22,000 Blackwell Ultra GPUs across Malaysia and the Philippines
summary: Aolani’s September 21, 2026 announcement says it expects to deploy 22,000 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs across two AI factories in Malaysia and the Philippines in early 2027. It says the collaboration brings its AI factory capacity above 100 MW and total deployment above 48,000 GPUs. These are forward-looking company statements: this review did not verify financing, construction, permits, delivery, operational capacity, utilization, or NVIDIA’s corroboration.
